title: Telling Time
subtitle: Clock times, daily routines, and event order

concepts.heading: Ask and answer the time
concepts.rule: 现在 (now) + 几点 (what time) makes a time question. An answer uses the hour + 点.

concepts.heading: Minutes and half past
concepts.rule: Place minutes after 点. For 30 minutes, 半 is a natural alternative to 三十分. Do not add 分 after 半.
concepts.formula: hour + 点 + minutes + 分 / 半

concepts.heading: Times of day and word order
concepts.rule: Put the time before the action. Both 我上午九点工作 and 上午九点，我工作 are natural.
examples: I work at nine in the morning.
I go to sleep at 10 p.m.

concepts.heading: First, then; before, after
concepts.rule: 先…然后… shows sequence. 以前 / 以后 mean before / after a stated time or action. These are optional extension expressions.
concepts.formula: 先 + action A，然后 + action B
examples: 我先吃早饭，然后去工作。
Wǒ xiān chī zǎofàn, ránhòu qù gōngzuò.
First I eat breakfast, then I go to work.
Bā diǎn yǐqián, wǒ chī zǎofàn.
Chī zǎofàn yǐhòu, wǒ qù gōngzuò.
After breakfast, I go to work.

stories.title: 我的一天
lines: 我每天七点起床，八点吃早饭。
Wǒ měitiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
I get up at seven and eat breakfast at eight every day.
Shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn wǒ qù gōngzuò.
I go to work at nine in the morning.
Wǒ zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn chī wǔfàn.
Xiàwǔ liù diǎn wǒ huí jiā.
I go home at six in the afternoon.
I go to sleep at ten in the evening.

stories.title: 几点见？
lines: Do you have time this afternoon?
Yes. What time shall we meet?
Xiàwǔ sān diǎn bàn, kěyǐ ma?

practice.question: 现在几点？ means…
practice.why: 现在 = now; 几点 = what time.

practice.question: Which expression means 4:30?
practice.why: 四 = four, 点 = o'clock, 半 = half past.

practice.question: Build: I eat breakfast at eight.
practice.why: Subject + time + verb: 我八点吃早饭。

practice.question: What comes after 点 to say 3:10?
practice.why: 三点十分 is 3:10. 分 is optional in some casual speech, but standard here.

practice.question: Build: First I eat breakfast, then go to work.
practice.why: 先 marks the first event, 然后 introduces the next.

practice.question: Type the pinyin (tone marks optional) for 下午.
practice.why: 下午 is xiàwǔ: fourth tone, then third tone.

practice.question: In 四点半, do we add 分 after 半?
practice.why: 半 already means half past; 四点半 is complete.

practice.question: Build: I go to sleep at ten in the evening.
practice.why: Time can come first: 晚上十点我睡觉。

challenge.question: How do you say 3:15?
challenge.why: 一刻 means a quarter (15 minutes).

challenge.question: What is 六点半?
challenge.why: 半 means 30 minutes past the hour.

challenge.question: Build: What time is it now?
Choose the correct pinyin for 工作.
challenge.why: 工 is first tone; 作 is fourth tone.

challenge.question: Type pinyin (tone marks optional) for 然后.
Which means 'before eight'?
challenge.why: 以前 = before; 以后 = after.

challenge.question: Build: I work at nine in the morning.
Choose 'I eat breakfast first, then work'.
challenge.why: 先 introduces the first action; 然后 introduces the next.

challenge.question: When is 晚上十点?
challenge.why: 晚上 is the evening or night.

challenge.question: Type pinyin (tone marks optional) for 睡觉.
challenge.why: 睡觉 has two fourth tones: shuìjiào.
